title: Comunicado 2026-09-24
summary: Banxico's Board unanimously held the policy rate at 6.50% with all members present, a third consecutive pause. The key change versus the 6 August communique is the forward guidance: the firm line that it 'will be appropriate to keep the rate at its current level' and that the stance is adequate is dropped, replaced by decisions conditioned on 'the continuation of the disinflation process' and its determinants -- a quiet reopening of the easing path without any explicit signal of a cut. The Board also added that monetary policy 'need not react mechanically' to the Fed's expected fed-funds moves, decoupling from the Fed's September hike despite a stronger dollar and higher US yields, and it cited slack, the absence of demand pressures and the degree of restriction already in place as inputs to the decision. The hawkish counterweights remain: headline rose on non-core, core forecasts were nudged up for Q3-Q4 2026 and the balance of inflation risks stays tilted to the upside. Net, the communique moves from a comfortable hold to a hold with a slight easing tilt; the minutes later showed a Board more dovish than this text, with three members openly floating a cut.

key_quotes.quote: Hacia delante, la Junta de Gobierno tomará sus decisiones considerando la continuación del proceso desinflacionario y el comportamiento esperado de sus determinantes, incluyendo el traspaso del tipo de cambio a los precios del consumidor, las condiciones de holgura y las expectativas de inflación.
key_quotes.context: New guidance replaces August's 'keep the rate at its current level': the path is reopened, conditional on disinflation continuing

key_quotes.quote: Dado que las condiciones macroeconómicas en México son distintas a las de Estados Unidos, la política monetaria no tendría que reaccionar de manera mecánica ante los ajustes previstos a la tasa de fondos federales.
key_quotes.context: Explicit decoupling from the Fed's September 25bp hike

key_quotes.quote: Valoró el comportamiento del tipo de cambio, que las economías de México y Estados Unidos atraviesan por etapas distintas del ciclo económico, la ausencia de presiones de demanda en México y el grado de restricción monetaria implementado.
key_quotes.context: Inputs to the decision lean on slack and accumulated restriction

key_quotes.quote: Se considera que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico mantiene un sesgo al alza.
key_quotes.context: Upside risk balance kept -- the brake that stops the text from signaling a cut
